items.description: Signed RB Zavier Scott from the practice squad to the active roster. Released DB Nick McCloud.

Signed TE Cam Grandy from Minnesota's practice squad to the active roster. Signed TE Caden Prieskorn to the practice squad. Placed TE Erick All Jr. on injured reserve and TE Josh Kattus on practice squad injured reserve.
Signed DL Amari McNeill to the practice squad.
Signed WRs Montorie Foster Jr. and Malick Meiga to the practice squad. Released FB Jackson Acker and LB Josh Ross from the practice squad.
Signed TE E.J. Jenkins to the practice squad. Released TE Jack Velling from the practice squad.
Placed DB Chauncey Gardner-Johnson on the reserve/suspended list.
Reinstated QB Dillon Gabriel from injured reserve. Waived TE Carsen Ryan.
Signed G Mekhi Becton Sr. from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed C/G Jacob Monk on injured reserve.
Designated WR Jack Bech to return from injured reserve.
Re-signed LB Jose Ramirez to the practice squad. Released C Jacob Rizy from the practice squad. Waived P Bryce Baringer from injured reserve.
Reinstated TEs Grant Calcaterra and Eli Stowers and G Landon Dickerson from injured reserve. Elevated LB Keyshawn James-Newby and RB Elijah Mitchell from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed OLB Nick Hampton from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed LB Ja'Markis Weston to the practice squad. Placed RT Taylor Moton on injured reserve.
Signed S Rayshawn Jenkins to the practice squad.
Activated CB A.J. Terrell from injured reserve. Signed DE Drake Jackson to the active roster. Placed OT Michael Jerrell on injured reserve.
Activated RB Dylan Sampson from injured reserve. Placed OL Teven Jenkins in injured reserve.
Activated RB Jonah Coleman and OLB Jonathon Cooper. Placed RB Tyler Badie and OLB Jonah Elliss on injured reserve.
Activated DB Brian Branch from the PUP list. Activated C Cade Mays from injured reserve.
Activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt status. Activated DT Jordan Riley off reserve/physically unable to perform list. Signed WR Coleman Owen from the practice squad to the active roster.
Signed DT Timmy Horne to the active roster from the practice squad.
Released P Thomas Morstead from the practice squad.
Placed RB Brashard Smith on injured reserve. Activated LB Cooper McDonald from injured reserve. Signed RB Jaydn Ott to the active roster from the practice squad.
Activated LB Kyle Louis from injured reserve.
Activated RB Jordan Mason from injured reserve. Released CB Natrone Brooks from the practice squad. Signed RB DeeJay Dallas to the practice squad.
Activating CB Paulson Adebo off injured reserve. Placing LB Tremaine Edmunds on injured reserve.
Placed LB Kiko Mauigoa on injured reserve. Signed LB Jaden Keller to the active roster.
